Genus Genus.reasoning: Contains the scientific names (taxonomic identification) of the organisms.
Genus Genus.reasoning_relevance: The column lists the scientific genus names of the Ephemeroptera species.

Abundance/Streams Altered.reasoning: Measures the count (abundance) of the organism in altered streams.
Abundance/Streams Altered.reasoning_relevance: This column records counts or sample sizes, which are excluded from biological data.

Abundance/Streams Preserved.reasoning: Measures the count (abundance) of the organism in preserved streams.
Abundance/Streams Preserved.reasoning_relevance: This column records counts or sample sizes, which are excluded from biological data.

Abundance/Streams Total.reasoning: Measures the total count (abundance) of the organism.
Abundance/Streams Total.reasoning_relevance: This column records a total count or sample size, which is excluded.
